summary: Operator site + map + Firefly page read: $50 weekday / $55 weekend water-electric sites (passes the gate at $50), season 04-15 to 10-15, showers, dump, Firefly booking. Not waterfront kept (RV sites ~60 m+ from the lake behind the beach lawn and trees; the map's interior 'pond' is a wetland meadow). Nightly share unmeasured. Google 4.5 (70).
flags: PRICE GATE: passes - cheapest electric RV night is $50 on weekdays (operator: 'Water & Electric Sites $50.00 -Weekday'), not over $50; summer peak $55 Friday-Saturday and holidays. The weekday package (Sun-Wed, Thursday free) brings a 5-night stay to $40/night. No Good Sam check needed.

LONG-STAY: nightly share UNMEASURED - Firefly availability is behind reCAPTCHA (not run) and the map does not mark seasonal sites. The park posts a nightly rate and runs an online nightly booking engine (test 2 passes); seasonal sites exist ('For seasonal sites contact ...'; Firefly: 'For seasonal stays, please call the office'). Imagery of the western grid (sites ~80-179, 212-261) shows many units with sheds and decks typical of seasonal campers, mixed with empty pads; it cannot give a share. No wording discouraging nightly guests found. Google 4.5 (70 reviews) - not iffy.

WATERFRONT: not waterfront KEPT. The stored waterfront_evidence ('no lake in frame') is wrong - Wilson Lake is at the NE corner of the park (shore ~44.1735,-89.1785) with the campground's own sandy beach, piers and a playground lawn. The nearest RV sites (69-72 and 1-12 per the map) sit ~60-90 m from the water behind that used beach/playground lawn and a treeline (Esri, 280 m crop at 44.1727,-89.1795); C1-C3 nearer the lawn are the cottages. So not on-water; a filtered lake view from 69-72 is possible but unconfirmed (no site photos) - default down. The map's interior 'pond' ringed by sites W5-W15 is a vegetated wetland meadow on imagery (44.1712,-89.1792), no open water. Proposed waterfront_evidence: 'operator map + Esri 2026-11-17: lake at NE corner beyond the campground's beach/playground lawn and trees, nearest RV sites (69-72, 1-12) ~60-90 m back; interior pond on the map is a wetland meadow - not waterfront'.

SITES: the map numbers about 240 sites (1-261 with gaps, M5-M10, W1-W15); no count written (the map's numbering has gaps and no seasonal/nightly split). Electric amperage for RV sites is not stated (the 30/50-amp line is in the cottage amenity list) - hookups.electric left unset.
